member.summary: The header magic that the AFS file will have.

member.name: P:AFSLib.AFS.AttributesInfoType
member.summary: The location where the attributes info will be stored. Or if the file won't contain any attributes.

member.name: P:AFSLib.AFS.EntryBlockAlignment
member.summary: The amount of bytes the entry block will be aligned to. Minimum accepted value is 2048, which is what most games use. But some games have bigger values.

member.name: P:AFSLib.AFS.EntryCount
member.summary: The amount of entries in this AFS object.

member.name: P:AFSLib.AFS.ContainsAttributes
member.summary: If the AFS object contains attributes or not. It will be false if AttributesInfoType == AttributesInfoType.NoAttributes.

member.name: P:AFSLib.AFS.AllAttributesContainEntrySize
member.summary: Returns true if all attributes contain the size of the entry. Some AFS archives contain each entry's size in their attributes, while others contain custom developer data. To access this data use the CustomData property of the Entry.

member.summary: Abstract class that represents an entry with data.

member.name: P:AFSLib.DataEntry.Name
member.summary: The name of the entry, which can't be longer than 32 characters, including extension. It can contain special characters like ":", be an empty string, and it can be the same name as other entries. For that reason, it's not safe to use this name to extract a file into the operating system.

member.name: P:AFSLib.DataEntry.SanitizedName
member.summary: An autogenerated name of the entry. It will be unique and won't contain special characters like ":". This can be safely used to name extracted files into the operating system.

member.name: P:AFSLib.DataEntry.Size
member.summary: Size of the entry data.

member.name: P:AFSLib.DataEntry.LastWriteTime
member.summary: Date of the last time the entry was modified.

member.name: P:AFSLib.DataEntry.CustomData
member.summary: In old AFS archives this usually contains the entry size, but in later versions it contains custom developer data.

member.name: P:AFSLib.DataEntry.CustomDataContainsSize

member.name: P:AFSLib.DataEntry.Unknown
